text:
aisha: DeployBot flagged canary 2 -> 2.9.1 p95 latency spike ~1.6x vs baseline. Auto-rollback did NOT trigger because the route is pinned. Manual rollback or unpin+auto? @mike @oliver

deploy-bot: [automated notice] Canary p95 470ms -> 760ms (threshold=500ms). auto-rollback: disabled due to route pin. See /deploy/logs/1875036789 :rotating_light:

sasha: How many customers hit the canary route? only internal tests?

mike: Traffic is 5% canary. Roughly 10% of requests hitting this route are latency-sensitive. Observability shows KV cache miss rate jumped right after deploy. I'm leaning manual rollback to 2.8.7, then debug. Need oncall + product ok.

oncall-sre: I'm here. Manual rollback is fine. I'll run infra checks (node draining, gke pods). Suggest pin the stable version immediately to avoid accidental promotion. Commands below.

mike: run:
```
redwoodctl release rollback --service=inference --to=2.8.7 --region=us-west-2
redwoodctl routes pin --route=/generate --version=2.8.7
```

oliver: I'll make the call to execute. Sasha please prepare the short comms for status page and internal channel. I'll execute in ~2m. :thumbsup:

sasha: Draft for status page: "We are performing a rollback of the inference runtime for /generate to address an observed latency regression in canary. No customer data impact expected. We're monitoring and expect restoration within 10-15 minutes." OK to post? :ok_hand:

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by oliver. Step 1/6: drain canary. Step 2/6: deploy 2.8.7 to canary. Logs: /deploy/logs/1875036789/step2

mike: Observability: p95 trending down — 520ms now. Keep an eye on KV cache miss as it recovers.

oncall-sre: Confirming: rollback completed, routes pinned to 2.8.7, canary traffic held at 0% until postmortem. Postmortem ticket created: https://internal/pm/1875036789 (triage -> perf regression)

oliver: Thanks team. Will block promoting 2.9.x until we bisect kvcache change. Action items: (1) bisect commits between 2.8.7..2.9.1 (mike), (2) reproduce in staging with kvcache disabled/enabled (eng-ml), (3) draft release notes/rollback rationale (product).

sasha: Posted status page and slack incident channel. Notifying a handful of beta customers via DM.

mike: Quick note — adding a check to deploybot to consider KV cache miss spike as auto-rollback trigger. Filing feature request.

oncall-sre: Leaving pinned hold tag and alerting infra if any eviction/ooms occur.

aisha: Good work. Closing thread after postmortem. :heavy_check_mark:
